title: Asset check
summary: Checks how well each enabled mod's models and textures are optimized (detail levels, triangle counts, shadows, culling boxes, lights, mipmaps, compression) and estimates their video memory use against the game resources they replace.
reading: Reading the textures and models of the mods and the game…
intro: Compares each enabled mod's models and textures with the game resources they replace: detail levels, triangle counts, shadows, culling boxes, lights, mipmaps, compression and video memory use. Based on file analysis, not measured in game.
